Frequently asked questions

How does the AI generate flashcards so quickly?

Our RAG system processes your PDFs using advanced language models to extract key concepts, generate cards with spaced repetition timing, and create visual mnemonics automatically.

What's the catch? Why not just use free apps?

Free apps like AnkiDroid have brutal UIs and steep learning curves. Quizlet makes you search for pre-made decks that are often wrong. We eliminate the busywork so you focus on learning.

Is my study data private?

Yes. Your PDFs and study progress stay on your device. We only sync encrypted metadata for the spaced repetition algorithm. We never sell your data or show ads.

What file formats do you support?

PDFs work best. We also support Word docs, PowerPoints, and plain text files. The AI extraction works on any textbook, syllabus, or study guide.

Do you really guarantee I'll pass my exam?

If you use the app for 30 days as designed and don't see grade improvement, we'll refund you 100%. This only works if you actually study the generated cards consistently.

How is this different from just highlighting textbooks?

Highlighting is passive. Our spaced repetition forces active recall. The AI asks you questions in different ways to ensure you understand concepts, not just memorize words.

Can I cancel anytime?

Absolutely. No contracts, no cancellation fees. Your study data stays on your device even after canceling. One-time purchases never expire.

What exams work best with ConceptUnlock?

Medical (MCAT, Step 1), nursing (NCLEX), law (LSAT, Bar), and any college exam with lots of memorization. Works especially well for science courses with complex concepts.
